topic_title: Legal Speed Limits for Texas Roadways & Beaches
prompt: What is the statutory prima facie speed limit in a Texas urban district unless otherwise posted?

options.text: Twenty miles per hour in urban districts and residential neighborhood streets
Forty-five miles per hour in urban districts and residential neighborhood streets
Thirty miles per hour in urban districts and residential neighborhood streets
Fifty miles per hour in urban districts and residential neighborhood streets
